# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — ODQ-001F Exact Final Candidate Owner Decision

Decision candidate: `SCI-FRUIT-ODQ-001F-DISPOSITION-B-R0.8`

Date presented: `2026-09-01`

Scientific owner: **project scientific owner; acceptance not yet recorded**

Status: **exact final candidate for owner review; not a recorded decision**

## Exact Candidate Decision

> Approve the repaired ODQ-001F Disposition B architecture as an exact,
> baseline-relative, profile/domain-aware development and qualification
> framework: exact historical Citlali is the paired scientific control rather
> than truth; separately authorized development, frozen held-out qualification,
> and challenge populations are disjoint and protected against duplicate and
> descendant leakage; methods, claims, populations, metrics, thresholds,
> multiplicity rules, and decision safeguards freeze prospectively; candidates
> must demonstrate protected scientific non-inferiority and material,
> statistically credible improvement in at least one owner-prioritized
> scientific dimension while passing truth/null, lower-tail, important-stratum,
> support, failure, unavailable-state, and catastrophic-regression safeguards;
> the result remains a Pareto comparison that prefers the simplest broadly
> adequate policy and permits material specialization, restricted
> qualification, or no replacement; out-of-domain behavior is explicit; and
> implementation-informed development remains quarantined from later
> implementation-blind Stage B authorship.

## Mandatory Bound Architecture

Acceptance of this record accepts all of the following as indivisible
requirements of ODQ-001F:

1. baseline-relative qualification, not global optimum seeking;
2. exact historical Citlali as paired scientific control, never as truth;
3. separate absolute truth-recovery and nuisance/null evidence;
4. disjoint development, qualification, and challenge populations;
5. duplicate, near-duplicate, and descendant-lineage leakage prevention;
6. prospective freeze of method, claim, profile, domain, population, metric,
   threshold, support, failure, multiplicity, and decision rules;
7. protected scientific non-inferiority across declared guards;
8. material improvement in at least one owner-prioritized scientific dimension;
9. sampling-, dependence-, uncertainty-, selection-, and multiplicity-aware
   statistical credibility;
10. lower-tail, important-stratum, failure, scientific-unavailability, support,
    and catastrophic-regression safeguards;
11. a Pareto trade space with no scalar-score default and specialization only
    when prospectively frozen evidence establishes material value;
12. preference for the simplest broadly adequate method or policy;
13. no-replacement as a valid qualification outcome;
14. exact out-of-domain behavior: authorized alternate, experimental override
    with downgraded claims, or typed scientific unavailability—never silent or
    best-looking fallback; and
15. an implementation-informed development / implementation-blind Stage B
    firewall and the complete claim-layer sequence.

These requirements are elaborated by the exact `r0.8` frame and its focused
companion rules listed in [`BUNDLE_MANIFEST.md`](BUNDLE_MANIFEST.md). The
manifest's path, byte-count, and SHA-256 bindings define the reviewed bytes.

## Exact Effects And Non-Effects

**ODQ-001F approval selects a development and qualification architecture.**

**It does not select ODQ-001 recurrence treatment, ODQ-001A–D state/update
semantics, a parent route, or a numerical method.**

**It does not launch the empirical lane.**

It also does not select a profile, population, metric, threshold,
parameter/adaptation policy, stopping rule, historical-compatibility route,
operational fallback, evidence generation, or qualification disposition. It
does not create or dispatch a Stage B packet, inspect or modify implementation,
execute a benchmark, open qualification data, validate performance, assert
readiness, alter production, or authorize Unity work.

## Acceptance Rule

A short paraphrase does not approve this architecture. Owner acceptance must
identify this decision candidate and the exact `r0.8` bundle manifest (or a
later explicit superseding revision). Until then, ODQ-001F remains open.
